description: Mark the two check_ins lists as paginated. The spec documents the `links` these lists return (its `OffsetLinks` and `TimeSeriesLinks` schemas) but marks no operation as paginated, so each was a single-page call. listCheckIns (GET /projects/{project_id}/check_ins) pages by number: `links.next` is the next page (`?page=N&per_page=M`), null on the last page. listCheckInEvents (GET /projects/{project_id}/check_ins/{check_in_id}/events) pages from newest to oldest: `links.older` is the next page (`?created_before=...&limit=M`), null when nothing older exists. The trait names that link (outputToken) and the query parameter that holds the position (inputToken); paginateHoneybadger in src/pagination.ts copies that parameter from the link into the next request. Source: the published spec, https://docs.honeybadger.io/api/v3/openapi.json.
